turns.user: What do you know about Omnigul?
turns.agent: Omnigul is the last of Crota's Generals. She is the architect of her masters wakening. As long as she lives, the threat of Crota's return will haunt this world. Track her down and exterminate every Hive that stands in your way.

Six of us went down into that pit. I was vain enough to believe we could defeat Crota, but the Hive caught his soul before we could destroy him and then there was only death. We failed. You cannot. Destroy the soul of Crota.

I do not sleep. I dealt with my demons by confronting them head on. The words they are saying are your personal truths. They are your thoughts, fears, and nightmares brought to life. That Nightmare is no more Uldren Sov than you are.
